## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ConsumingAnApiSecuredWithOau`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `consuming-an-api-secured-with-oauth2`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ConsumingAnApiSecuredWithOau**.

## Step 2: Steps to consume an OAuth2 secured API

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev). -->
2. <!-- manual: Select your project and navigate to the Overview page in the left navigation. -->
3. <!-- manual: Select the integration as API that you want to consume. -->
4. <!-- manual: In the integration Overview page, on the right side, click the Developer Portal icon. This will open the Developer Portal for the selected API. -->
5. In the Developer Portal, select **Subscribe** to subscribe the API to an application.
6. <!-- manual: If you already have an application, select it from the list. If not, enter a name for a new application and click Create Application. -->
7. Once the application is created, click **Subscribe** to complete the subscription process.
8. In the left navigation menu, select **Applications** and select your application.
9. Select **Manage Keys** at the top right of the application page.
10. <!-- manual: Under the OAuth2 Keys section, click Generate Key. -->
11. A dialog box showing the credentials will appear, which you can close after noting down the necessary details (You can modify the **Advanced Configuration** if needed).
12. <!-- manual: To test the API, click Generate under the Token subsection. This will generate an access token using the OAuth2 client credentials flow. -->
